page_title: Soju: Windows game launchers on Apple Silicon Macs

sources.entry: Soju - Installs the official Windows Battle.net, Steam, Epic, GOG, EA app, Rockstar and Ubisoft Connect clients on Apple Silicon through Wine and Apple's GPTK, with a native library of all your games. summary.name: Soju
summary.one_liner: Soju is a free, open-source Mac app that runs the official Windows game launchers (Steam, Battle.net, Epic, GOG GALAXY, EA app, Rockstar, Ubisoft Connect, Xbox PC) on Apple Silicon through Wine and Apple's Game Porting Toolkit, with one combined game library.
keywords: play windows games on m1 m2 m3 m4
use_cases: Play Steam games on an Apple Silicon Mac
Run Battle.net titles like Diablo II: Resurrected on macOS
Consolidate Windows game launchers into one Mac library
Run Epic or GOG games without Windows
Try a Whisky or CrossOver alternative for free
Check which Windows games run on a Mac before buying
summary.what_it_does: Soju installs the real Windows Steam, Battle.net, Epic, GOG GALAXY, EA app, Rockstar, Ubisoft Connect and Xbox PC launchers on Apple Silicon Macs, each in its own Wine setup. Battle.net, Epic and GOG use a Wine engine built from CodeWeavers' sources with Apple's D3DMetal; EA, Rockstar and Ubisoft use a copy with DXMT; Steam gets its own Wine 11 setup with DXMT. It finds installed games across launchers into one library and can import owned Steam and GOG games. It includes a store search for Steam, GOG and Microsoft Store prices, and an experimental Xbox PC import through the Xodus backend. The page lists tested games with results (for example Diablo II: Resurrected plays online, Hogwarts Legacy plays, GOG GALAXY reaches login only), and a soju doctor command checks the setup.
notable: Runs official store launchers (Steam, Battle.net, Epic, GOG, EA, Rockstar, Ubisoft, Xbox PC) rather than individual games
Free and open source under GPL-3.0-or-later, Wine engine built from CodeWeavers' published sources
Terminal install via soju install, Homebrew, or install script; soju doctor and soju update commands
caveats: Games with kernel-level anti-cheat won't run
Xbox PC support is experimental; Xbox PC tested only to main menu
Steam games need macOS 26 or later; Diablo II: Resurrected needs macOS 26.4+; the app needs macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon
Only a limited set of games has been tested on one M4 Pro Mac; other games may or may not work
